    “Reading is relaxing to me,” Lena argued. “But if you want to help me relax and have fun, I know of a few ways much more enjoyable than cold water,” she said adding a sultry tone to her voice as she walked closer to Kara, placing her head on Kara’s shoulders.

    Kara gulped, eyes falling to Lena’s lips, but when she tried to move forward, Lena stopped her with two fingers on her lips.

    “Isn’t your family looking?”

    Kara took Lena’s hand in hers and kissed her fingertips.

    “Let them look,” she said carelessly and leaned in to capture Lena’s lips.

    -------

     

    Later that evening found everyone lounging in the living room, all freshly showered and tired from a day at the beach, bellies full from the delicious dinner Eliza and Lena made.

    Lena sat cross-legged at the edge on sofa, finishing her book, while Kara’s head rested on her shoulder trying not to doze off; Alex laid on the other couch, sprawled like a cat, and Winn sat on the floor, his back against the couch right in front of Lena, playing with his portable game.

    “It’s like having a house full of teenagers again,” Eliza mumbled to herself as she walked back into the living room, slapping Alex’s feet away so she could sit on the sofa, but not complaining when Alex’s feet fell on her lap.

    “You know what? We should play trivia,” Winn said out of nowhere. “I found an old trivia pursuit on the guest room.”

    “Kara is practically asleep,” Alex pointed out.

    “’m not,” Kara halfheartedly defended, but it had no impact since her cheek was entirely squished against Lena’s shoulder and her voice was groggy.

    “Perhaps tomorrow?” Lena offered.

    “We could play without Kara,” Winn tried.

    “Absolutely not,” both Lena and Alex said together, and then looked awkwardly at each other.

    “I mean, Kara would be upset if we played without her,” Alex reasoned.

    Winn huffed. “Fine,” she grumbled with a pout. “I’ll just stick to my Pokémon.”

    Not much later, Kara let out a tiny little snore that made all women laugh fondly at her, Winn being too distracted by his game to notice.

    “I think that’s our cue,” Lena said to no one in particular. “Kara, darling, come on, let’s get to bed.”

    Kara hummed contently and let Lena guide her to a standing position.

    “Goodnight everyone,” Lena wished politely, and Kara parroted with a groggy ‘’night”, they were answered by a small chorus of ‘good night’.

    “Sleep well, girls,” Eliza said.

    Lena smiled at her, genuinely, and not the forced smile she was used to giving most people; it was just so easy to like Eliza, she was so warm and kind, not unlike Kara, and Lena craved that time of attention from a mother.

    “You too, Eliza,” Lena answered, and then proceeded to pull a sleepy Kara up the stairs, which was actually a very easy task, as sleepy Kara was also floaty Kara.

    Lena got Kara into her PJs and onto bed with familiar ease and slipped in next to her, and Kara immediately draped herself over Lena, using her soft girlfriend as a pillow; Kara’s favorite pillows, as she mentioned one too many sleepy nights, were Lena’s boobs because they were ‘just so soft and warm and squishy’. Lena smiled at the blonde head on her chest and started carding her fingers through the soft curls, which made Kara practically purr into her.

    “Did you have fun?” Kara managed to ask even in her near sleep coma state, always worried about Lena’s comfort.

    “Yes, I did, darling, thank you.”

    Kara hummed in contentment. “Good.”

    “Just sleep, Kara,” Lena told her with a laugh.

    “Hm, g’night Zhao.”

    “Goodnight, darling.”

     

     

     

     

    “Isn’t it funny how this week has three Sundays?” Winn mentioned on Monday morning, during breakfast.

    “Not really,” Kara said. “Yesterday was Sunday, and tomorrow will be Sunday again, but today is actually kind of Saturday.”

    Winn hummed as he considered her logic. “Does this mean another Shabbat? Cuz I’ve got stuff to do in Johto, I’m not above hiding in the roof to play Pokémon.”

    “Next level nerd, the both of you,” Alex scoffed at Winn and Kara, and the two stuck their tongues out at her.

    Lena liked watching the three of them interact, especially Kara and Alex, it was a special kind of bond they had, something that came from a deep love and from knowing each other for many years; it made her happy to know Kara had that, and it made her miss what she had and what she didn’t have with her own brother.

    “You okay?” Kara asked softly, snapping Lena out of her thoughts. When Lena looked at her inquisitively, Kara shrugged. “You seem a bit distant, that’s all.”

    “I’m fine, darling,” Lena assured her, taking a sip of her coffee. “Just thinking.”

    “Good things?” Kara asked with a tentative smile.

    Lena couldn’t help but smile back at Kara. “Only,” she said, and Kara’s smile widened immensely.

    “So what are we doing today? Are we going to the beach again?” Winn asked, pulling Kara’s attention away from Lena for a second.

    “Oh no, you do not want to go to the beach today. Or tomorrow, for that matter,” Alex said with her nose scrunched up in disgust.

    “Why’s that?”

    “Never go to the beach on a holiday in the summer unless you want to be smothered by half-naked strangers sticky with sunscreen and sweat and covered in sand who have no fears and are willing to do anything for a nice spot,” Kara answered.

    Winn frowned. “O-kay?”

    “It’s just a thing you learn when you live by the beach, when to go and when not to go, for starters. Yesterday was already full, but people were still arriving in town, today is going to be packed, and you do not want that,” Alex explained.

    “Having to fight for a strip of sand changes a person,” Kara added dramatically, and Alex agreed with a nod.

    Winn looked at Lena and the woman just shrugged.

    “Don’t look at me, I have only ever been to private beaches.”

    “Brag much?” Winn mumbled loud enough for Lena to hear, she laughed and he winked at her. “What about poker?”

    “I’m not giving money to Luthor,” Alex said adamantly.

    Lena raised her eyebrows a little. “That’s fair. Though you are assuming you would lose, which I don’t disagree with, but I never pegged you for one to give without a fight, Danvers.”

    Alex glared at Lena, eyebrows knitting together in irritation as she stared daggers at the woman and Lena held her eyes unbothered. “Oh, it’s on, Luthor.”

    Kara and Winn both could tell Alex had made a mistake when they saw the minuscule curl of Lena’s lips, but Alex was too bind by competitiveness to notice it.

     

    They decided to not use money, something Lena herself was pretty adamant, knowing all three of them lived on rent, and instead went for the leftover snacks in their cars.

    It was with a table full of gummy bears and M&M’s and all kinds of candy evenly distributed to each of them that the most important battle of their lives was fought. It looked more like Halloween than a pre 4th of July afternoon.

    Kara was pretty terrible, Lena learned early on, but she didn’t seem to care about it, though she could always tell when Lena was bluffing; she ate half of her betting material instead of actually using them for betting, and they had to make a rule against eating your ‘chips’, so Kara just went and got herself the remaining bag of chips from Lena’s car to munch on.

    “Lena, do you want a kiss?” Kara asked in the middle of a round, and when Lena turned to face Kara, the blonde was holding a Hershey’s Kiss on her palm with a ridiculous grin on her face.

    “You dork,” Lena said, rolling her eyes fondly.

    Winn was mildly decent, but only because he was good with the cards, he couldn’t bluff for shit and the girls would always call on his bluff only to have him break his face most of the time.

    “Kara, that’s my leg you’re rubbing up, just so you know,” Winn mentioned casually without taking his eyes off his cards. “Call.”

    Kara blushed bright pink and tried to shrink down in her seat while Lena hid her own embarrassment by clenching her teeth hard and focusing on the game, avoiding eye contact.

    Alex had a very displeased look on her face as she raised Winn’s bet.

    “Sorry,” Kara mouthed to Lena, but the brunette sent her a reassuring smile.

    “Don’t worry,” Lena mouthed back.

    Alex was good. Good enough to make things interesting for Lena. She was good with the cards and very good at bluffing, and she played with a cocky grin for most of the game, probably just to scare Winn.

    “Don’t even try to pretend you have something good, Winn, you’re not a good enough bluff,” Alex accused when Winn raised Lena’s bet.

     Winn shrugged but didn’t back down.

    Kara folded in the next round and tried to peak at Alex’s card, but Alex pushed her away.

    “I don’t want you ruining my game,” Alex said, and Kara pouted.

    “You can look at my cards, darling,” Lena offered, and Kara was back to smiling.

    She scooted closer to Lena, dragging her chair ungracefully, until she was very close, and then dropped her head on Lena’s shoulder. Lena smiled softly at that and showed Kara her cards, to everyone’s surprise, and the dismay of Alex and Winn who were waiting for it, Kara didn’t react, just gave a little hum and nuzzled Lena’s shoulder.

    “Oh, come on,” Winn groaned. “The one time we need you to be expressive.”

    Kara shrugged, fake apologetically and straightened herself on her chair, but placed her hand on Lena’s leg.

    “You have to result to silly cheating tactics to win, Winslow?” Lena asked with a disappointed lilt in her voice, and the clicked her tongue.

    “Ugh, I fold.”

    “Just you and me, Luthor.”

    Lena smirked at Alex, with a raise of her left eyebrow.

    After a few tense moments of them just staring at each other and going back and forward on their bets, Kara couldn’t take it anymore.

    “I’m gonna see if Eliza wants some company and not be here while you two glare at each other over candy,” Kara announced as she got up.

    “It’s not about the candy,” Alex and Lena said in unison.

    And Kara just rolled her eyes at them and walked away.

    “Hello, sweetie,” Eliza greeted her when she stepped out into the deck. “Got tired of poker?”

    Kara smiled and sat next to Eliza.

    “Something like that,” Kara said. “It’s not the most fun game, I’ll tell you.”

    Eliza chuckled.

    “Well, I’m glad you’re here while the others are busy, I wanted to talk to you alone,” Eliza said as she marked her book and set it down.

    Kara frowned. “Did I do something wrong?”

    “No, sweetie, nothing like that,” Eliza reassured. “I just wanted to talk to you about Lena.”

    “What about Lena?” Kara asked carefully.

    “You really love that girl,” Eliza said, it wasn’t a question, just a statement.

    But Kara answered anyways, with a nod she affirmed: “I do.”

    “Have you told her?” Eliza’s tone was taking a more serious note. “Have you said the words? In Kryptahniuo?

    “I have.”

    “And does she know?”

    Kara frowned. “I just told you I-”

    “I mean about Kryptonian traditions,” Eliza cut her off. “Specifically, the mating ones.”

    Kara felt her cheek burn hot and started stuttering an incoherent answer.

    “I don’t mean about the sex, Kara,” Eliza told her gently.

    Kara blushed even more, dropping her head, shame creeping up around her chest to grip her heart.

    “No,” she admitted.

    Eliza looked at her with just the tiny hint of disappointment, along with a lot of sympathy.

    “You have to tell her, Kara,” she said firmly, in the most motherly voice she could have possibly used.

    Kara’s shoulders sunk the slightest bit more.

    “I know, but I’m afraid,” she confessed. “She has a hard time dealing with and expressing feelings, her family was, well, is messed up, and I’m the first serious relationship she’s had; if I tell her I can’t be with anyone else for the rest of my life… I don’t really know how she’ll react. I don’t want to scare her off, I don’t want to lose her.”

    Eliza nodded her understanding but said nothing.

    “It’s not exactly a lie, you know, I’m not deceiving her by not saying it. In fact, it’s the opposite, because that way I don’t put this burden on her. What if she feels pressured to be with me? If she thinks she can never break up with me? It’s my culture, she doesn’t have any obligations to follow it.”

    “I don’t think she has any intention of breaking up with you at the moment, sweetie,” Eliza told her with a smile. “Just the fact that she’s here shows how much she’s invested. Besides, she has a right to know.”

    Kara knew Eliza was right, but she didn’t know how she’d even begin to tell Lena that according to Kryptonian culture they were mated from the moment Kara professed her love to her, and Kryptonians didn’t believe in divorce.

    On Krypton, romantic love was a rare thing, since marriages were arranged, previously by an algorithm that pointed out the best unions, and later by the head of the house - it was political, a merger between two houses, designed to make both houses stronger - most married couples never experienced it. And that made romantic and sexual love so important. Kryptonians believed that when two people experienced that kind of love for each other, the love they called Zhao, it meant that Rao himself wanted them to be together; for that reason, Zhao was also a word for lover, in English terms, it would be translated as soulmate.

    That love was so important for Kryptonians, so precious, that it was the only way a marriage could occur aside from being arranged. When the words ‘.:Zhaoodh khuhp w rraop’ were said out loud to one another, the couple was bonded forever.

    Kara was fully aware of this when she said the words to Lena, it was a conscious act, one that she stood by and did not regret, and yet she had no idea how she would ever explain it all to Lena.

    After a bit of thinking, and a warm hug from Eliza, Kara went back inside where the game was somehow still going between just Lena and Alex; Kara deposited herself back in her seat and scooted close to Lena again, placing a kiss on her girlfriend’s shoulder. Lena smiled at her, and Kara felt the grip around her heart, both from her love for Lena and from the newfound guilt of not telling her about Kryptonian customs.

    Not long after, Lena won, much to Alex’s dismay. She didn’t gloat or brag, just smiled and slid all her candy wins towards Kara.

    “Go crazy,” she said jokingly, smile only getting bigger at the excitement on Kara’s face at seeing all the candy that was now hers.

    Rao, .:Zhaoodh khap w Lena, Kara thought as she shoved a red vine in her mouth.

     

     

     

     

    And so it was Tuesday. The 4th of July. One of the days Kara dreaded the most in the entire year.

    Lena had elected herself to help Eliza in the kitchen, while Kara, Alex, and Winn set everything on the backyard.

    They were going to spend the day outside because it was a very nice Summer day. The Danvers house had an entire grassy hill that looked out into the ocean for a backyard, and they made the most out of it whenever they could.

    “I have something for you later,” Lena told Kara when the blonde went into the kitchen to grab a tablecloth.

    Kara frowned. “You know 4th of July isn’t commonly a gift-giving holiday, right?”

    “Just humor me.”

    “Then why can’t you give it to me now?”

    Lena shrugged. “I like making you wait.”

    “You are a cruel woman, Lena Luthor,” Kara accused jokingly.

    Lena smirked at her. “It’s in my genes.”

    Kara rolled her eyes and walked out of the kitchen. Lena went back to her task, noticing Eliza was watching her with a smile on her face.

    “Kara has never been a very patient person,” Eliza mentioned.

    Lena chuckled. “One time I told her I had a surprise for her, and she spent the entire day annoying me to know what it was, she sent me about twenty texts in a span of five or so minutes.”

    Eliza laughed. “That sounds like her. I’ve always had to be creative with hiding spots for presents, for anything, really, Children’s day, birthdays, Hanukkah, she wouldn’t rest until she found her presents.”

    “I’ll have to keep that in mind, her birthday is getting close.”

    “You’re a smart woman, I’m sure you’ll figure it out.”

    -------

     

    “Can I get my present now?” Kara asked Lena once everything was settled outside, making grabbing motions with her hands.

    Lena’s heart swelled at the excitement lighting Kara’s face more than the sun itself, and she had to bite her lip to contain herself.

    “It’s not really a gift,” Lena explained. “Just something I’ve been working on since that big storm three months ago.”

    Kara frowned at that. “And you chose to give it to me today?”

    “It’s… pertinent for the events of today.”

    “The… fireworks?” Kara asked confused.

    Lena grinned and leaned forward, kissing the tip of Kara’s nose. “I knew you were more than just a pretty face.”

    “I thought you were with me for my muscles,” Kara joked back.

    “That too, I can save up on private security.”

    Kara laughed, that beautiful full laugh that made Lena fall for her, that made her heart flutter in her chest and butterflies fill her stomach, made her icy Luthor façade melt.

    “Alright, come on,” Lena said, caving even though Kara wasn’t even trying anymore.

    Kara squealed happily and grabbed Lena’s hand to follow her into the house.

    In Kara’s childhood bedroom, Lena rummaged through one of her suitcases with a purpose, opening a compartment inside a compartment inside a compartment.

    “It’s really well hidden,” Kara commented as she watched Lena.

    “Well kept,” Lena corrected. “I just didn’t want anything to happen to it.”

    She then pulled a small box from her bag, black and round and about the size of her palm, and turned back to face Kara, straightening herself.

    “Lena?” Kara asked suspiciously. “You’re not about to propose, are you?”

    Lena scoffed. “I hope you know I’d do better than a 4th of July in your old bedroom, right before my first kosher barbecue.”

    Kara laughed. “I’m sorry.”

    “Okay, so, do you remember that night of the thunderstorm?” Lena started. “We were dancing when it started and within seconds you were, well, a mess; terrified of the noises outside, stuck in your memories… I don’t really have to explain it to you how you react.”

    Kara shook her head. “Yeah, I got the idea. But no, I don’t remember. All I remember are the bruises I left on you that night.”

    Kara’s eyes turned glossy for a second, and she took a step closer to Lena and touched her waist gently as if she was seeing the bruising on Lena’s skin all over again.

    “Hey,” Lena said softly, making Kara look up at her again; Lena pressed a kiss on Kara’s cheek and waited for the smile to come back to Kara’s face. “You know I hate seeing you in pain, I wish I could make it all go away. But while I can’t take all your pain away, there’s something I can do.”

    Lena opened the box and handed it to Kara.

    Kara cocked her head to the side, a confused small frown on her brows.

    “Earplugs?”

    Inside the box were two small metal plugs with black foam at the tip.

    Lena chuckled at Kara’s reaction.

    “Noise canceling earplugs,” Lena said. “Or rather, super noise canceling earplugs.”

    “Okay…”

    “Winn helped me with them. They are solid lead, which we know muffles your powers, but there’s a little extra at the tip based on the tech Winn built for you to fight that banshee woman.

    “Oh,” Kara said, starting to understand it.

    “It’s not something for you too use all day every day, but,” Lena paused and took a little breath is, biting her lower lip for a second “it should help today, with the fireworks.”

    “Oh!” Kara exclaimed, now that she really understood it.

    Lena laughed a little bit.

    “The density of the metal, along with your powers’ reaction to lead, prevent the sound waves from penetrating, and the foam helps isolate it all the better. It works like your glasses but enhanced. And then the tech comes in, to fend off all the high decibel sounds, it completely cancels out anything above 90 decibels, which means the fireworks will be muted out,” Lena explained. “You can still hear, though,” she continued as Kara plucked one of the plugs from the box to inspect it closer. “Your body still conducts sound through waves to your inner ear, and your powers, though muffed, still work, so it’s like turning the volume of the world down. You can still hear yourself, and the conversations… basically anything below 90 decibels you can hear just fine, only a little lower than you’re used to; human level.”

    Lena finished her rant and chewed on her lip nervously as she watched Kara, tensely waiting for a response.

    It took a moment, but soon Kara broke into a large smile and Lena’s nerves were mollified.

    “You’re amazing, you know that?” Kara said to Lena before pulling her into a kiss. “How can you be this great? You created a completely new tech just so I wouldn’t be in pain,” Kara continued to gush. “Rao, I love you.”

    Lena’s heart soared. No matter how many times she heard those words, it still felt like the first time; she felt them deep in her bones, and in her lungs, making it harder to breathe and so much easier at the same time, like the air was lighter; she felt it all over her body, in every cell, making her body buzz with exhilaration. She felt a warmth that she never felt in her entire life before she met Kara; she felt safe, loved.

    “I would do anything for you, Kara,” Lena admitted, and Kara looked at her with an impossibly larger smile and pulled her in for another kiss.

    Later in the evening, after all the food was gone, and the sun had set, the fireworks ignited the sky and Kara pulled Lena closer to her.

    “I had never been able to experience Fireworks before,” she told Lena, lips brushing against Lena’s ear so she’d be heard. “Thank you.”

    Lena smiled at Kara, who had a look of wonder splashed across her face that was worth all the long extra hours she had worked on the lab just to make the plugs perfect.

    And when Kara kissed her, the fireworks in the sky seemed dull compared to the ones behind her eyelids.

     

    Chapter End Notes

    Well, that's it, see y'all in six months.

    I'm just kidding. I don't know when I'll be able to post this again, but I know it won't be very soon, since now that I updated this I have a few other fics to update, and some other things in the works, but I promise this will not be abandoned, I very much intend to finish this story.

    Also if there's any confusion, kryptonian has gendered and non-gendered words for you and me, so khuhp and rraop are non-gendered, while khap and rrip are feminine words, so that's why both were used here when talking about love.

    Anyways, as always kudos and comments are literally the only thing I live for in this cold world, my tumblr is @myheartisbro-ken and you're free to come chat.
    Love you all, and thanks for sticking around for this story 😘

    In Which This is an Epilogue

    Chapter Summary

    Kara and Lena have a night in that doesn't quite go as planned, but it's perfect for what it is.

    Chapter Notes

    This is goodbye folks.

    I just wanted to say a few things here, I know I usually say a lot because apparently verbal hyperactivity also extends to written words, but it's been a while and it's important to me.

    Okay, so let me just say the understatement of the century that the pandemic hasn't been easy. It's still very much alive and kicking in my country, it's not the best time to live in brasil (and boy did we have some problems before). I know a lot of writers continued to write, some more than they used to, but I haven't been able to get back into writing consistently since the pandemic started, and it's taken me some time to accept that it was okay that I wasn't dealing with a terrible situation in a sane and happy manner as if it was just a fun vacation. So yeah, I've been stressed, I've been overworked with online classes, I've been beating myself up for not managing to 'turn these terrible times into art', and I've been dealing with a lot on top of the pandemic and that just left me without a lot of time or a good headspace to write.
    I'm just saying all of this to tell all of you that I never really abandoned this, I got this question many times, but no, I never abandoned this story, in the sense that I gave up on it; I thought about this story almost every day, I have been upset this entire time over not being able to continue, but I just couldn't. I had many many ideas for it, I have a folder with over 16 docs of ideas and plots and scenes that I wanted to add, and I love this story very much, but I have decided to stop letting it hang any longer, and to stop forcing myself and just accept that this story has ran its course.
    I decided to read it over and when I got to the end, I realized that although it's not the ending I had planned, and although it's probably not the best ending I could have written in another time, last chapter was a satisfactory enough ending for me. I believe it's a decent enough closing point, and it felt like the best place to end it rather than trying to drag it out and ruin it, or just stay unfinished forever.

    What I am going to do, though, not to leave y'all with a simple 'it's over, go home' note, is add what was going to be a scene in the next chapter as an epilogue. I wrote this waaay back in 2019, I was working on it when I posted the last chapter, and I like it too much not to share it, so I wanted to leave you all with this. as a thank you for sticking around and putting up with me as I figured out how to write more than some random scenes that never saw the light of day. I know it's not much, but I couldn't leave it without one last fluffy hurrah.

     

    A few months after coming back from Midvale, Kara found herself in Lena’s - or rather their, as it was now - penthouse, relaxing on the couch with Lena’s head on her lap as the brunette slept soundly.

    It was the first moment in weeks that they managed to spare for each other, and Lena fell asleep less than forty minutes into it. Kara didn’t blame her at all, the brunette had been working so hard in the past weeks, leaving the office way after hours and getting home much later than usual.

    Kara herself had had crazier hours than usual as well. With Snapper punishing her for every time their ideas diverged and just being his regular demanding self, and crime and accidents in National City peaking for no apparent reason, she too hardly had time to breathe.

    They had both spent the weeks torn between not wanting to bother the other, who they knew was working hard, and needing the comfort of each other, and yet never managing to be home - or at least free - at the same time. Many a times, Lena would arrive at their place to find Kara already asleep, or not even home yet, only for Kara to be gone by the time she woke up; and Kara kept getting whisked away by super business, and the occasional overnight assignment, whenever they managed to catch each other home.

    It was tiring. It was torture. It was taking its toll on both of them.

    Eventually they managed to clear their schedules enough to spend a Saturday evening together.

    Lena had planned a whole date for them, taking a page from Kara’s book and quite literally writing it all down in her tablet to make sure everything was perfect. Candle lit dinner, home cook food, wine, nice music playing on the sound system, the final episode of that show they were watching together and hadn’t had time to finish yet, expensive lingerie and that tight blue dress with the deep cleavage Kara liked so much, she even wrote down a 20 minutes make out session on the couch before they’d eventually retire to bed and spent all night making up for the lost time.

    But Lena had been so tired that she dozed off almost as soon as they got to the couch.

    Kara knew Lena would blame herself, feel bad for not being able to stay up and finish their date, but she wouldn’t have it any other way; she was the happiest she had been all week, loosening her coiled up muscles and watching the woman she loved finally relax after days and days of stress. Lena’s jaw slacked against Kara’s thigh and her brows unfurrowed under Kara’s gentle fingers.

    She paused the show, less than ten minute in, and gave herself a few minutes to appreciate Lena’s sleeping form before picking her up to take her to bed.

    Lena let out a soft little groan when Kara lifted her up from the couch, and her eyes fluttered open.

    “Kar?” Lena mumbled confused, hazy green eyes searching for Kara’s, grey with sleep.

    “I’m right here, i zhao,” Kara told her softly, adjusting Lena in her arms.

    “M’sorry,” Lena mumbled, head lolling to the crook of Kara’s neck.

    “Sshh, just sleep.”

    And with a sigh, Lena’s eyes fluttered close and she fell back asleep.

    But Kara realized when she arrived in the bedroom, that she probably shouldn’t have told Lena to sleep just yet. In a normal night, Kara would just place Lena on the bed and lay down next to her, and that would be it, at most she’d have to take Lena’s jeans off so she’d be more comfortable; but Lena was currently wearing an extremely constrictive dress that would not be great to sleep in, and Kara wasn’t sure if she’d be able to remove it without ruining it or having to wake Lena up.

    More often than not, when Kara tried to remove Lena from her fancy clothes, especially dresses and skirts, she ended up breaking the zipper or even tearing the fabric. Lena assured Kara that she didn’t mind, that she didn’t care about the clothes and if Kara wanted to tear them off, she could, even encouraged Kara to do so, but Kara still felt bad when it happened by accident, and she really like this particular dress, so to ruin it would be shameful.

    Thus, started Kara’s struggle of trying to wrestle Lena out of the dress without waking Lena up. It wasn’t an easy feat, Lena was actually quite a fussy sleeper when not snuggled against Kara, wiggling around and grunting her displeasure, and Kara had to put a lot of effort into being extra careful and gentle with the delicate clasp and zipper.

    But eventually, Kara managed to get the dress open and down Lena’s shoulders.

    The vision she got was absolutely breathtaking, and Kara could not stop the very audible gasp that came out of her lips at seeing Lena in the expensive lingerie.

    Kara had seen Lena naked quite a few times through the course of their relationship, even more times in her underwear, it wasn’t a particularly new or exotic sight; but it was still utterly delectable each time. To say Lena was attractive would be an understatement, even before they started dating Kara already admitted Lena was probably the most gorgeous woman she had ever seen in her life, and there was no need to deny Kara was very much physically attracted to Lena. So obviously, Kara knew firsthand that Lena Luthor in lingerie was a sight to behold, even better than all seven wonders of the world combined, one could say she was even used to it, but every time she got to see it, she was affected all the same, as if it was the first time and she couldn’t believe that this goddess was in front of her, was allowing her to not only see her like this, but also touch her.

    This particular three-piece set was embroidered voile in dark green and gold, bra thong and ouvert, with black straps surrounding Lena’s waist, over her breasts, along her ribs and her back, on her crotch, going between her thighs and over her butt to secure the ouvert in place, and between her butt cheeks. The dark green and black worked really well with Lena’s pale skin - she always looked good in green - and Kara could tell it would make Lena’s eyes pop if she was awake, she could also tell that the golden buckles were made of actual gold; she knew that because Lena had a favorite brand of lingerie which apparently made all the hardware in 24K gold.

But now Kara really appreciated the effort it took to look that good, she knew the amount of preparation that Lena had to go through to wear lingerie like that, some even painful, not that she deemed necessary, but Lena needed to do it to feel good in it. Now Kara was excited to know that all of that was bought and put on with her in mind, that it was for her to see only, like a carefully wrapped personalized gift. And she knew Lena liked how something like that made her feel, that she felt good and sexy and powerful, seductive, she knew that Lena liked the effect it had on her.

Another thing Kara knew about Lena, was that she really didn’t mind sleeping in borderline uncomfortable underwear, but Kara just wanted Lena to sleep well, she really needed the rest, and a thong and a bodice bra, with all the straps along her ribs - or any bra at all, for that matter - just wouldn’t do it.

It wasn’t a strength slip up, and Kara was sure Lena wasn’t hurt, she was just ticklish in that specific spot Kara’s thumb pressed, the spot that never failed to make Lena literally jump; like a full body spasm.

    “I’m just taking your dress off, Zhao.”

    And with Lena’s gain of awareness, she managed to tug the dress the rest of the way off.

    “I can see that,” Lena said back, waggling both eyebrows at Kara.

    A giggle bubbled out of Kara, and she squeezed her hand on Lena’s hip, not where she was ticklish, just for a little pressure.

    “I’m trying to make you more comfortable,” she explained, nuzzling Lena’s temple and pressing a kiss there.

    “Indeed,” Lena agreed, still in that tone that was intended to be sultry, but just made it obvious how tired she was. “Let me help you get more comfortable.”

    Before Kara could process it, Lena was twisting herself on the bed and raising to her knees as she reached for Kara. Lena held herself on Kara’s shoulder for stability for a moment, then slid her hands down along Kara’s collar, uncoordinated fingers fumbling with the top button of Kara’s shirt.

    “Lena, what are you doing?”

    Lena looked up at Kara, intense and serious through heavy eyelids. “What does it look like I’m doing, Kar-ah?” Lena slurred.

    Between suppressed giggles, Kara said, “we’re not doing this right now.”

    Lena pouted, Lena Kieran Luthor was pouting.

    “Why not?” she asked, too tired to even sound offended. “I’ll make it worth your while,” she told her as she leaned her body more heavily towards Kara, her hands sliding back up to Kara’s neck to try and pull Kara closer.

    “You’re tired, princess, let’s just go to sleep, okay?”

    But Lena was not having it.

    “We can sleep later, darling,” Lena insisted. She managed to pull Kara closer, but only because Kara was afraid that she was going to fall, and pressed her lips to the corner of Kara’s a little too forceful. “Let me keep you awake tonight,” she breathed against Kara’s cheek.

    Kara gasped when Lena tried to yank her shirt open, lacking in force and managing to only loosen the first two buttons.

    “Lena, stop,” she laughed.

    Lena pulled back with a frown.

    “Don’t you want to fuck me, Kara?” and now she did sound offended.

    “Not while you’re falling asleep, Zhao,” Kara told her gently.

    “I’m not falling asleep,” Lena argued. “I’m fully awake for you to,” she interrupted herself with a yawn, “for you to,” she yawned again and frowned annoyed, “for you to rail me,” she said through the yawn.

    And that was the last drop for Kara, and she burst into giggles. That was just the most adorable thing she had ever seen, and she couldn’t believe how much she loved her.

    But before Kara could tell Lena just that, Lena was crying.

    “Lena,” Kara gasped, her giggles halting in her throat. She reached for Lena, but the woman dropped herself on her ass.

    “I’m sorry,” Lena cried. “I’m so sorry. I ruined everything.”

    Kara climbed in bed, on her knees, and inched closer to Lena, pulling Lena to her and cradling Lena’s face in her hands.

    “Hey, Zhao, it’s okay. You didn’t ruin anything.”

    “I did, I ruined the night,” Lena sniffled. “It’s been so long since we got to spend time together and I wanted to give you a great night. I planned everything, I waxed my entire body, I cooked, I got us my best wine, I bought nine hundred dollars’ worth of lingerie, and I managed to get into it with all these straps, and now I can’t even stay awake for long enough for you to fuck me,” she lamented.

    Kara wanted to laugh, she really wanted to, and she considered a great feat of will power that she managed to hold back.

    “I Zhao, look at me,” Kara asked, as she wiped Lena’s tears with her thumbs. Lena’s eyes looked so impossibly green through the tears that Kara almost gasped. “Hi,” she whispered when their eyes met, smiling at Lena with all her love, and to her surprise Lena’s lips curled up in response, although just a little. “I love you so much,” she said before anything else.

    Lena sniffled again, her bottom lip trembling as she leaned into Kara’s touch.

    “I just wanted tonight to be perfect,” she whispered brokenly.

    “And it was, Zhao! It was,” Kara assured, kissing Lena’s cheek. “I can see how hard you worked on it, and it means a lot to me. And I loved it. I loved everything. I loved the food, I loved the wine, loved the look… I love every moment we get to spend together, so just being with you was already enough for me to make it a perfect night.” She kissed Lena’s other cheek, letting her lips linger on the warm skin for a second more. “But you’re so tired and you need to sleep; I know you haven’t been sleeping well.”

    Lena twisted her lips and looked down, almost ashamed to not be taking better care of herself.

    “Now there’s nothing I want more, in the multiverse, right now, than to sleep in your arms, to end this night really well.”

    “Yeah?” Lena asked unsure.

    “Yeah. You think you can handle that?”

    Lena nodded, dropping her head to Kara’s neck for a second.

    “You’re amazing.”

    Kara smiled, rubbing her hand on Lena’s back.

    “I can say the same about you,” Kara said as her hands slid over the straps over Lena’s ribs. “Let me get this off for you so we can enjoy it some other night.”

    Lena nodded against Kara’s neck and helped Kara remove the voile contraption off her body. As the bra fell off, Lena actually sighed in relief, and Kara chuckled gently. The pale skin was slightly reddened by the restrains, and Kara lowered her head to graze her lips along Lena’s ribs.

    “.Nahn rrip w :zrhueiaouse,” Kara whispered against Lena’s skin as she pressed kisses along the marks. When she was satisfied she covered everything, she moved to the other side. “You’re so beautiful,” she repeated in English.

    Kara practically purred when she felt Lena’s fingers treading on her hair, the blunt nails scratching her scalp gently. She pulled away from Lena, who was once again sitting at the edge of the bed, and looked down at the marks along the pale hips. Kara’s hands fit perfectly on Lena’s hipbones, as if they were meant to hold Lena like that; she ran her thumbs over the marks gently.

    “You know I think you are the most breathtaking person I have ever seen,” Kara whispered to Lena. “You don’t need this whole production.” She placed a kiss right bellow Lena’s ear and then watched as the hairs on Lena’s neck raised. “Although it is very much appreciated.”

    Lena smiled groggily at her.

    “For someone who just wanted to make me comfortable to sleep, you are taking your time with me naked,” Lena teased, managing to get the whole sentence out before a yawn overtook her.

    Kara didn’t even bother with a response, just kissed Lena on the lips once the yawn was over and took off into the closet in superspeed, coming back a second later in an old baggy t-shirt and pajama shorts. She handed Lena a baggy t-shirt and shorts of her own and went to remove the coverlet and the decoration pillows, which she only got halfway through when she heard a disgruntled groan.

    “Wha- oh my god,” Kara laughed as she made her way back to Lena.

    “Don laff ah me,” Lena mumbled from behind the t-shirt stuck halfway down her head.

    “I’m sorry, you’re just too cute when you’re tired,” Kara said, helping Lena untangle herself. She kissed Lena on the lips once she was free. “There you go, sleepyhead.”

    “Thank you.”

    Both dressed in their comfortable sleepwear, they got under the covers and Lena curled up entirely on top of Kara, but she wouldn’t close her eyes as heavy as they were, fighting her hardest to keep them open, not wanting to look away from Kara.

    Kara smiled at her and kissed the tip of her nose gently.

    “Sleep, i Zhao, I’ll be right here when you wake up.”

    Lena looked at her unsure, vulnerable, as if afraid that Kara would disappear the moment she closed her eyes, which did happen a few times.

    “You promise?”

    “I do,” Kara said softly. “There’s absolutely nothing in the whole multiverse that would get me out of this bed. So please, just stop fighting it and rest already; I’ll make you pancakes in the morning.”

    “Okay,” Lena nodded and rested her head on Kara’s chest.

    Kara nuzzled Lena’s hair and then placed the softest kiss on her forehead, right in her hairline.

    “I love you,” she whispered against Lena’s hair.

    For a second, she thought Lena didn’t hear it, that she was sound asleep, but then she heard it.

    “You too,” breathed out against her shirt, and she could feel the breath through the fabric, in the skin right above her heart.

    She gasped out for breath, overwhelmed for a second. Her heart slamming so hard against her ribcage she was afraid it’d wake Lena, but it just lulled the woman to a deep sleep.

    Kara had never doubted Lena’s feelings for her, knew that just because Lena wasn’t ready to say the words out loud like she herself was so comfortable doing, didn’t mean that Lena didn’t feel the same way, Lena’s actions told her everything she needed to know. But that was the closest to saying ‘I love you’ that Lena had ever gotten, and it meant that she was getting more comfortable with voicing her feelings, that she had come a long way since they started dating, and that knowledge made Kara feel like her heart was going to burst.

    ------

     

    It should have made Kara sleep well, or at least that’s what she thought, hearing a confirmation that the person you love loves you back should put one at peace, and it did, in a way, but Kara couldn’t really sleep.

    She spent the entire night listening to Lena’s heartbeat, feeling Lena’s breathing on her skin and the soft warm body against her own, it was the most at peace Kara had been for as long as she could remember. Her heart was literally soaring, like an oversensitive muscle being stroked pleasurably; and yet, it was almost as if she was afraid to miss a second of this literal angel that she held in her arms. She never thought she would get to feel this way about anyone, her entire life on earth she always felt alienated from the rest of the world, as if she was missing something, as if no matter how hard she tried, she would never truly fit in, but Lena made her feel normal, made her feel understood and seen. It was like her entire life had been building up to this moment that she’d get to hold this wonderful woman that owned her entire heart and soul in her arms dressed in matching unicorns and rainbows pajamas feeling complete for the first time since her home died, and she wanted to enjoy this moment for as long as she could.

    Eventually the sun came up, and for Kara it felt like the night had lasted an eternity yet not long enough; soon Lena would wake up and Kara’s lovesick bubble would be burst in the best possible way, because she’d get to hang out with Lena, hear her voice, see her beautiful green eyes that reminded Kara of the crystal mountains of Argo and that gorgeous bright smile that outshined Rao himself. Not for the first time Kara whished her mother was still alive so she could tell her all about Lena, about her Zhao, she remembered her parents’ relationship, the way they complimented each other in every way, the companionship they had, the innate understanding of each other, she had always dreamed that one day she’d get to have what they had, a dream that she thought had died along with Krypton, but Lena proved her wrong, and she wished she could tell her ieiu that she did find her own Zhao after all that she’s been through.

    Kara could tell the exact moment Lena started waking up, her heartrate went up a little, and she let out this tiny little whine at the back of her throat, imperceptible to human ears, and a few seconds later Lena’s arms tightened around Kara’s waist.

    “How long have you been watching me sleep for?” Lena’s lovely groggy voice asked in a rasp.

    Kara let out a little breathy laugh and pressed her lips to Lena’s forehead.

    “If I tell you it’s been all night will it sound creepy?”

    “That depends,” Lena said back, without opening her eyes, nuzzling her nose against Kara’s neck.

    “On what?”

    “What you were planning to do.” It sounded suggestive, or as suggestive as Lena could muster while half asleep still.

    “Nothing,” Kara said simply. “I was just appreciating you. I like listening to your heartbeat.”

    Kara heard Lena’s heart skip a beat, her breath hitch just a little, before she composed herself and hummed, nuzzling even closer to Kara, her cold nose rubbing just above Kara’s pulse point.

    “Well, it’s yours,” Lena whispered, and all functions in Kara’s body stopped.

    “Wh-what is?”

    Lena sighed prettily and pressed a gentle kiss on the side of Kara’s throat that Kara was sure, if her breathing hadn’t already stopped just seconds before, would have stolen all the breath from her lungs.

    “My heart,” Lena said, as soft as the press of her lips to Kara’s skin, and Kara wanted to cry, she wanted to laugh, wanted to scream at the top of her lungs, but she settled for tightening her arms around Lena just a little and pressing her own lips to Lena’s shoulder.

    Nothing else needed to be said. If Lena never managed to say the three words back to her, Kara would be satisfied with just that statement; in her heart, that alone solidified their bond, and there was only one thing she could say to that.

     “Kehpodh rrip w khap i zhor.” The Kryptonian words fell easily from her lips, the vows she never thought she’d get to say; she was Lena’s and no one else’s. “Uldif.” Forever.

    It was then that Lena finally detached her face from Kara’s neck and pulled away just enough to look at her, green eyes hazy with sleep and the charged moment.

    “What does that mean?” Lena asked curiously, she tried to repeat the words, but her throat wasn’t made for it.

    “You own my heart,” Kara translated. Even if Lena’s feelings changed, no matter what happened to them, her heart would always belong to Lena. “For,” she paused for a split of a second, too short for the human brain to capture, but just enough for her to hesitate in completing the word and say instead: “as long as you will have it.”

    “Forever?” Lena asked hesitantly, timidly, and Kara was sure she had never heard Lena so vulnerable.

    Kara smiled softly at her and leaned forward to kiss her; it was no more than a brush of their lips, but that was enough to tell all that Kara wanted to say.

    “And more,” she added to Lena’s question.

    The air was charged between them, neither one breathed, their hearts beat as one and Kara was sure Lena could feel it too; perhaps not to the extent Kara did, perhaps she couldn’t quite understand what it meant to Kara, but one does not need to fully understand something to feel it, and Kara knew, in her heart, that Lena felt it too.

    “Kara, I-” Lena tried to say it, but her words caught on her throat.

    “I know,” Kara told her. She really did, she could feel it, could feel it and nothing else in that moment, could see it in her eyes, could hear it in the way her heart was beating against hers, in the way her breath was both rapid and slow at the same time. “Me too.”

    Lena let out a soft groan of frustration.

    Before she could formulate her words though, Kara smiled and reached out to brush a lock of her hair behind her ear.

    “You don’t have to say it,” Kara said gently. “There’s no hurry, okay? I know it. A few words won’t change anything.”

    Lena bit her lip and took in Kara’s words, before letting her head drop into the crook of Kara’s neck.

    “Ugh. Why do you have to be so perfect?” Lena huffed into Kara’s shirt.

    “I’m Supergirl, it comes with the territory,” Kara joked. “Now come on, I promised I’d make you pancakes.”

    But Lena didn’t move, nor lifted her head from Kara’s neck. “You spoil me too much.”

    “Said the billionaire.”

    Lena breathed out a laugh as she rolled off Kara, head leaning sideways to still rest on Kara’s shoulder.

    “You know there are things money can’t buy,” Lena told her.

    Kara nuzzled Lena’s hair and breathed out a “yeah, I know.”

    A moment passed.

    “You’re talking about my abs, right?” Kara asked, prompting Lena to burst out laughing.

    -------

     

    Lena never thought she would be one to enjoy covering a stack of pancakes in syrup, but after tasting it off of Kara’s lips she developed a taste for it.

    Lena really liked Kara’s pancakes, it was the best thing Kara could do in the kitchen, even if Kara’s cooking skills were expanding, her pancakes remained the best thing in her repertoire. Or perhaps Lena just like the intimacy of someone making her pancakes in the morning after they woke up together, the syrup covered kisses, the sleepy smiles and the conversations about nothing; she never had it before in her life, with anyone, and it was genuinely her favorite way to spend the morning.

    Kara was radiant like the sun in the mornings that they got to spend together, even more so than the rest of the day, throwing Lena smiles as they ate, stealing kisses, bumping her bare feet against Lena’s under the table, she even tried to hold Lena’s hands sometimes, but it made it hard to eat, so she would give up after a few minutes. Overall, mornings together were particularly enjoyed by the two of them.

    After a particularly sweet kiss, Lena felt a bitter taste in her mouth as memories of the previous night came to the forefront of her mind.

    Kara must have noticed the shift, because her smile dropped to a frown, the crinkle between her brows popping. “What’s wrong?” she asked, rubbing her thumb across the back of Lena’s hand.

    Lena shook her head, trying to tell Kara not to worry, but that was never a message that really came across, she knew Kara always worried.

    “I just, I’m sorry for last night,” she told her.

    “You have nothing to be sorry for, i zhao,” Kara assured her.

    I Zhao, Lena still felt her heart skip in her chest when Kara called her the Kryptonian equivalent of ‘my love’. She knew, from what Kara had told her of her culture’s view on love and romance, that it held so much more weight than the English phrase, that romantic love was a rare thing to come by and was not taken lightly. Sometimes a wave of anxiety washed over her, fearing she would end up ruining things, end up breaking Kara’s heart and letting her down because she didn’t know how to deal with such strong emotions; but, at the same time, it made her feel elated that Kara had chosen her, that Kara loved and trusted her that much. No one had ever truly loved her like Kara did, which was why she always tried her best to show Kara how important she was to her, despite her inability to voice her feelings.

    “I embarrassed myself,” Lena said, shaking her head, feeling her cheeks heating up. “I ruined our night. I acted like a petulant child.”

    But Kara simply smiled at her. “I found it quite endearing.”

    “You’re teasing me.”

    “Am not! I promise,” Kara insisted. “I don’t think there’s anything you could do that would make me less enamored by you.”

    Lena was positive her cheeks were bright red by that point, but she tried to play it cool. “Aren’t you using big words today.”

    Kara just glared playfully at her. “Don’t be rude, I’m saying I like you, you meanie.”

    With a smile, Lena pulled Kara in for another sugary sticky kiss. “I like you too, darling,” she said against Kara’s lips.

    “You try to act all tough, but you’re a softie deep inside,” Kara teased before pressing her lips to Lena’s again.

    Lena just sighed and rested her forehead against Kara’s.

    “Are you sure you didn’t think it was pathetic?”

    She didn’t need to add more context for Kara to know what she that she was talking about the previous night again.

    “Why would I?” Kara asked seriously. “Lena, I would never think that of you. Come on, you gotta give me a bit more credit here.”

    She closed her eyes and dropped her head to Kara’s shoulder. “I’m sorry, I’m embarrassed.”

    “I told you, there’s nothing to be embarrassed about, i zhao,” Kara insisted again. “You were tired, and you fell asleep, it’s perfectly fine. I know how much you’ve been working. It didn’t matter at all, to me, any time that I get to spend with you is perfect to me. And you know I love sleeping next to you.”

    “Yes, but I… Kara,” Lena groaned. “I begged you to... I cried when you didn’t.”

    “Crying is a perfectly normal emotional release, again, you were tired, it’s okay, Lena. And I like knowing you’re attracted to me enough to cry because I’m not touching you,” Kara joked.

    Lena slapped Kara’s arm, harder than she had intended, and hissed when her hand made contact with steely skin.

    “Oh, are you okay?” Kara asked concerned, taking Lena’s hand gently in hers and blowing cold air into her fingertips.

    “No,” Lena groaned grumpily, but there was no sign of great pain in her voice.

    Kara pressed soft kisses to the tip of each red finger and then right in the middle of Lena’s palm.

    “Let’s make a deal then,” she started. “If you are so embarrassed by last night, we can just pretend it never happen,” Kara suggested, then bit her lips and smiled as slyly as one like Kara Danvers could. “Although I would very much love to get a second chance to appreciate that green three piece.”

    “That can be arranged.”

    “Yeah?”

    Lena nodded and Kara leaned in to kiss her again.

    “Okay, so now can we both agree that last night was not the worst thing to ever happen in our relationship?” Kara asked jokingly.

    “Only if you tell me what was the worst thing that ever happened in our relationship.”

    Kara shrugged. “Easy. That time you ate my last pot sticker.”

    “You gave it to me, you offered it.”

    “Yeah, but I was hoping you’d deny it and say that I needed it way more than you and let me have it.”

    Lena rolled her eyes and pushed on Kara’s shoulder, lightly, more mindful of the fact that Kara had the density of a brick wall, and Kara allowed herself to be pushed back as she giggled.

     

    “Do you have any plans for today?” Kara asked as she did the dishes after they finished eating.

    Lena was pressed almost entirely to Kara’s back, arms wrapped tightly around Kara’s waist, or as tight as she could without hurting herself. “How about staying in our pajamas all day and doing nothing?” she suggested, face mushed into Kara’s shoulder.

    Kara hummed, as if considering the suggestion as she closed the tap and dried her hands, before turning around inside Lena’s arms.

    “Have I ever told you you’re a genius?”

    Lena smiled and shrugged with one shoulder.

    “Not in those words, no.”

    She tried to stay serious, but Kara’s grin was not something she could resist, and what started as a breathy laugh became a full-blown giggle that made her blush.

    As Lena’s cheeks started reddening and she hid it in Kara’s shoulder, Kara smiled.

    “How can you be so cute?” Kara teased.

    “I’m not cute,” Lena scoffed, muffled by Kara’s shirt, but it came out weak. “I’m a businesswoman.”

    Kara could only smile, nose scrunching and everything. She pulled back from Lena a little bit and held Lena’s face with her hands so she’d look at her.

    “You are,” Kara said, placing a kiss to Lena’s heated cheek, “the cutest girlfriend,” she kissed the other cheek, “I’ve ever had,” Kara finished, kissing Lena’s nose.

    Lena smiled at that, her cheeks reddening even more, but she didn’t try to hide them, instead she let Kara look at her face, with that beautifully happy smile Kara reserved for only her, sparkling eyes and everything.

    As she looked at Kara, Lena’s lungs felt too full, as if she pulled in too much air, suffocating in the air that wouldn’t come out, she needed to get it off her chest.

    “I,” she started, but the words were stuck in her throat, she gasped, but nothing left.

    The way Kara smiled at her was almost knowingly, as if Kara could read her mind, knew why she was gaping like an idiot while she stared at her girlfriend’s bright blue eyes.

    “I think you’re the cute one,” Lena said instead, and she knew that they both knew it wasn’t what she was going to say.

    Kara shrugged, the smile never leaving her face.

    “We can both be the cute one.”

    Lena pretended to think for a moment, and until she finally couldn’t contain a grin from splitting her lips.

    “I think can live with that compromise,” she said then.

    “Yeah?” Kara asked, smile unwavering.

    Lena nodded and lifted herself to her tiptoes to brush her lips against Kara’s.

    “Definitely!”

I have never tried my hand at a multichapter, in fact I had only done a handful of single scenes and 'this is what I would have liked to see in the episode' one shots before I decided to put some of those together to create this. Writing this really helped me grow as a writer and gain more confidence in myself to write more challenging stuff that I really wanted to try out; it gave me so many nice messages about this silly hobby of mine that I started doing to deal with less than great times in my life and never thought I was any good at; and it also gave me some friends that I'm very thankful for and that I can share my particular kind of weirdness with and feel less alone in this crazy fucking world. So I owed it to it to give it a proper closure and to let it finally be one of those 'complete works' it has always wanted to be.

    I know most people don't really care all that much but I needed to say that, so yeah, thank you all very much, it has been great, and that's it for this one.
